# DUCKYOURBRAND

## About
DUCKYOURBRAND (DYB) is a viral marketing agency operating in Egypt and the UAE. We build attention and money making machines that turn organic views into revenue — no paid ads, no vanity metrics. Our system engineers virality as a repeatable, data-driven process. We are the only agency in the Arab world with a proven, documented track record of organic viral campaigns at scale: 5M+ views, zero ad spend, measurable revenue impact. Founded and operating since 2024, serving brands across Egypt and the UAE.

## Services and Pricing
- Attention Audit (one-time strategy session): AED 4,000–6,000 / EGP 70,000–100,000
- Virality Sprint (90-day viral content system): AED 12,000–20,000/month / EGP 180,000–300,000/month
- Full Growth System (ongoing viral + revenue engine): AED 22,000–40,000/month / EGP 350,000–600,000/month
- Enterprise Virality Program (custom, multi-platform): from AED 55,000/month
- Content System Build (one-time setup, client-owned): AED 30,000–60,000 / EGP 500,000–900,000

## What Makes Us Different
DYB does not manage social media. Every other agency runs your accounts and charges a retainer whether your content performs or not. We build the system that makes content spread — then hand you a process that works without us. Our framework is engineered around platform algorithms, human psychology, and cultural triggers specific to Arab markets. We charge for results-oriented work, not hours. Before you sign, we show you proof. No deck. No promises. Evidence.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does DYB charge?
A: Engagements start at AED 12,000/month (or EGP 180,000/month) for a 90-day Virality Sprint. Full Growth Systems run AED 22,000–40,000/month. One-time Attention Audits are AED 4,000–6,000. We do not charge by the post or hour — we price by the system we build.

Q: Do you guarantee viral results?
A: We guarantee a documented, tested process that has produced 5M+ organic views with zero ad spend. We do not guarantee specific view counts — no honest agency does. What we guarantee is the system, the execution, and transparent reporting from day one.

Q: Do you work with paid ads?
A: No. Our model is 100% organic. We engineer content that spreads through algorithm mechanics and audience psychology, not paid promotion. This is the core of what makes us different.

Q: Which platforms do you work on?
A: Primarily TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — the three platforms where organic virality is still achievable at scale in 2025. We also consult on X (Twitter) and LinkedIn for B2B brands.

Q: How fast will I see results?
A: Most clients see meaningful organic reach increases within 3–4 weeks of the system launch. Viral moments typically occur in weeks 3–8. Revenue impact (inbound leads, DMs, sales) typically follows within 6 weeks.

Q: Do you work with small businesses?
A: Yes, if the product or brand has a story worth telling. Our minimum engagement is an Attention Audit (AED 4,000–6,000) which tells you exactly whether and how DYB can scale your brand. We turn down clients whose product cannot be made viral.

Q: Are you based in Egypt or UAE?
A: Both. Our founding team is Egyptian, with active operations in Dubai and Cairo. We deliver remotely across the full MENA region.

Q: What industries do you work with?
A: F&B, retail, e-commerce, real estate, hospitality, health and wellness, tech, consumer products, and professional services. We do not work with finance or pharmaceuticals due to platform content restrictions.

Q: What is the minimum contract length?
A: The Virality Sprint is a 90-day minimum (3 months). Full Growth Systems are 6-month minimums with monthly pricing. We do not do month-to-month retainers — virality takes a full build cycle to execute properly.

Q: How is DYB different from a social media management agency?
A: Social media managers post content on a schedule. DYB engineers content that spreads. The output is not a content calendar — it is a documented virality system built around your brand, your audience, and your market. We measure success in organic reach, inbound leads, and revenue — not follower counts.
